name: Extreme heat
value: Severe to extreme heatwave, northern Australia
summary: Severe to extreme heatwave warnings across northern Australia; heat warnings in Mozambique to 8 Nov
state: Australian warnings on 4 Nov were at severe level across the Pilbara, much of the Top End and northern Queensland, and extreme for the Kimberley, North Interior and Tiwi Islands; Fitzroy Crossing reached 45.1°C on 3 Nov (IQAir). The Bureau of Meteorology's Queensland warning of 7 Nov says severe to extreme conditions will persist through next week (WillyWeather). Mozambique's weather service warned of 37–43°C to 8 Nov (Club of Mozambique). This crosses the regional-warning line for Watch; no deadly heatwave with top-tier warnings over a large population was found as of 8 Nov.
for_you: In Australia, follow Bureau of Meteorology heatwave warnings. The Bureau says severe heatwaves are dangerous for many people, especially older people, babies, children and those with medical conditions, and extreme heatwaves are dangerous for everyone.
rubric_hit: Watch: heatwave warnings across a major region (severe to extreme warnings across northern WA, NT and northern Queensland, 4–7 Nov)

why: Heat is the deadliest weather hazard globally, straining power grids, crops and health systems.
drivers: Heat domes, climate warming, season, humidity, urban heat islands.

rubric.alert: Deadly heatwave with top-tier official warnings across a large population.
rubric.watch: Heatwave warnings across a major region, or national temperature records.
rubric.normal: No major heatwaves affecting large populations.
